nodes.description: mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf tracking token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance for spender approvals
address private owner, privileged account controlling delegate and batchSend
uint public totalSupply of the token
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable forwards to transferFrom
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable with ensure modifier guard
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable owner-only mass transfer loop
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure computes Uniswap pair address
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable initializes token and owner
msg.sender external caller address used across transfer, approve, delegate, batchSend and constructor
low-level a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary owner-supplied code in contract storage context
unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend
unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath
_to recipient parameter of transfer
_value amount parameter of transfer
_from source parameter of transferFrom
_to recipient parameter of transferFrom
_value amount parameter of transferFrom
_spender parameter of approve
_value parameter of approve
a target contract address parameter of delegate
b raw calldata bytes parameter of delegate
_tos recipient array parameter of batchSend
_value per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend
_name token name parameter of constructor
_symbol token symbol parameter of constructor
_supply initial supply parameter of constructor
factory address parameter of pairFor
tokenA parameter of pairFor
tokenB parameter of pairFor
local uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend
loop local address _to = _tos[i] in batchSend
local address pair computed in pairFor
local address token0 ordered in pairFor
local address token1 ordered in pairFor

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as _from when transfer calls transferFrom
msg.sender is used as spender key for allowance[_from][msg.sender] check and decrement
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve
require(msg.sender == owner) gates execution of delegate
require(msg.sender == owner) gates execution of batchSend
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints balanceOf[msg.sender]
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
_to parameter flows into transferFrom call inside transfer
_value parameter flows into transferFrom call inside transfer
_from parameter is used for allowance, balanceOf and Transfer event in transferFrom
_to parameter is used for balanceOf credit in transferFrom
_value parameter drives allowance and balance mutations in transferFrom
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented by _value
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are updated by _value
_from indexes balanceOf for balance read and write
unchecked balance subtraction may underflow balanceOf entries before require guard ordering
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by approve
_value parameter is stored as the approved allowance amount
allowance[msg.sender][_spender] is set to _value
address a is the delegatecall target supplied to delegate
bytes b is the delegatecall calldata supplied to delegate
delegate executes the low-level a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation
_tos recipient array is iterated to credit balances in batchSend
_value per-recipient amount is credited in batchSend
_value is multiplied by _tos.length to compute local total
_tos.length array size participates in the unchecked total multiplication
batchSend performs the unchecked multiplication operation
result of the unchecked multiplication is stored in local total
total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath
loop local _to receives balanceOf[_to] += _value credit
batchSend loop assigns each element to loop local _to
_tos[i] element flows into the loop local _to
the ensure modifier on transferFrom calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply and decimals
constructor sets owner to the deploying account
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable
_supply parameter is scaled and stored into totalSupply
factory argument is hashed into the computed pair address
tokenA argument participates in pair ordering and hash
tokenB argument participates in pair ordering and hash
pairFor computes and returns the local pair address
ordered token0 is hashed into the pair address
ordered token1 is hashed into the pair address
